schemas.about: calendars: events on the days of a month
charts of numbers: series of values by category
diagrams of nodes joined by edges, in groups, laid out by the diagram's kind
the conversation of a session as state: last request and result per tab, reactions, assumptions, open questions
written documents: chapters, sections, paragraphs, slides and sentences, each sentence with the facts it states
a drawing of placed objects with sizes, colours, labels, groups and edited parts
a drawn face: parts with their variant, colour, size and place, and an expression
lists of entries in order, which can be ticked off
a map of the world: places of k.geo shown, highlighted and pinned, and the view's zoom and layer
meetings at exact times, with the people, rooms and calendars they use
who a person is: name, age, occupation, languages, family, likes and dislikes
depictions with an explicit background, scene and depicted parts
standing preferences: a key, its value or the fields of a described value, a scope, a source and when it was stated
the meaning of one request: an act, a target and constraints
rooms with explicitly stated names and seating capacities
a seating plan: tables, seats and the guests on them
tasks to do, each open or done, with a due date, an owner and a reminder
retained text sources and explicitly anchored formatting spans
timelines: events in order of time
